draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 86th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 17th of 35 at WR. He went 80th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kenny Stills. Testing standouts: broad jump (90th percentile). College production: 798 receiving yards in 2023, 20th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 14 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2024. Weak spots: receiving td 0 (13th percentile), approximate value 1 (18th percentile).
